summary: Ansible 12 community.windows deprecations: win_audit_policy_system, win_audit_rule, win_auto_logon, win_certificate_info, win_computer_description, win_credential, win_dhcp_lease, win_dns_record and win_dns_zone redirect to ansible.windows, and the redirects go away in 4.0.0.
questions: Which FQCN should I use for win_auto_logon?

answer_card.title: community.windows modules moving to ansible.windows
answer_card.answer_md: These now redirect to `ansible.windows`; update the FQCN because the redirects are removed in community.windows 4.0.0: `win_audit_policy_system`, `win_audit_rule`, `win_auto_logon`, `win_certificate_info`, `win_computer_description`, `win_credential`, `win_dhcp_lease`, `win_dns_record`, `win_dns_zone`. For example use `ansible.windows.win_dns_record`.
